answer: In an AI agent economy employing Sybil resistance, the mechanism relies upon a **willow**-like reputation system where creating new identities incurs substantial resource costs. Each new Sybil node requires purchase, initiating a **gale** of economic activity visible across the network. An attacker pooling resources into multiple nodes fails to build genuine reputation, limiting their system influence significantly. Any negative interaction instantly **ripples** across reputations, deterring most attempts. The economic hurdle is the core defense.
